description: This file defines the AppTheme class, which provides theme data, constants for spacing and radii, and styling configurations for a Flutter application. It includes theme customization for buttons, input decorations, switch, checkbox, navigation bar, and other UI components, utilizing Flutter's Material 3 design system.

classes.name: AppTheme
classes.description: A utility class providing static theme data, constants, and style configurations for the app's UI.

methods.name: AppTheme.theme
methods.description: Returns a ThemeData object configured with custom color schemes, component themes, and text styles for the application.

methods.name: AppTheme.headerGradient
methods.description: Provides a linear gradient used in headers or flexible space areas, combining primary color with a light background.
